name: Clipboard shelf
author: ReidenXerx
description: Pin the snippets you paste all day and keep them one keystroke away, alongside your clipboard history. Reads Omarchy's own clipboard history, so nothing is captured twice.

barWidget.description: Pinned snippets and clipboard history; click to open, type to filter, 1-9 to paste

schema.label: Rows to show
schema.description: How many entries the shelf lists at once, pinned included.

schema.label: Preview length
schema.description: Characters of each entry shown on its row before it is truncated.

schema.label: Show the type glyph
schema.description: Mark each row with an icon for what it holds — link, colour, path, code, image. Colours show a swatch of themselves instead.
